name: Runeveil
detailed_description:
Welcome to the Mystical World of Runeveil!

Master ancient runes and weave devastating elemental spells in this captivating roguelike deckbuilder. Strategically combine magic spells to charge enough spell power to overcome various crystal guardians. Ascend mystical towers, enhance your arsenal, and unleash spectacular barrages of spell effects from single, perfectly crafted hands!

KEY FEATURES

  • Dynamic Runic Deckbuilding

Collect 60 unique runes, each blending core elements with defining symbols. Refine your deck by adding, enchanting, or removing runes, and acquire specialized relics to forge a spell set that perfectly mirrors your strategic style.

  • Multiplicative Spell Casting

Forge potent runic combinations from harmonized elemental chains to daring fusions of energy. Master runes that trigger their magic multiple times, unleashing a flurry of distinct spells from a single hand! Skillfully stack these cascading spell effects in one turn to see your score and power skyrocket as you obliterate stage targets.

  • Strategic Quadrant Placement

The board itself is your ally. Its distinct, upgradable quadrants imbue runes with unique benefits: amplify effects or multiply scores. Master tactical placement and develop your board for monumental payoffs.

  • Potent Relics & Mystical Aid

Discover ancient relics offering game altering advantages, enhancing specific elements or rewarding particular combo styles. Utilize consumable potions and enduring blessings to manipulate runes, gain resources, or ensure the perfect finishing spell.

  • Challenging Roguelike Ascent

Journey through increasingly difficult stages demanding intricate spellcraft. Defeat formidable crystal guardians with unique constraints, earning enduring meta upgrades that unlock new runes, relics, and blessings for future runs.

  • Boundless Replayability

With a vast array of runes, countless synergies between relics and blessings, and scaling Ascension difficulties, Runeveil constantly invites bold experimentation and rewards creative strategies long after your first victory.

  • Embrace Pure Magical Chaos

Ascend infinitely, upgrading your runes and board to unimaginable power. Witness spell combinations unleash an almost incalculable torrent of magical energy and scores!

supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Pentium CPU G860
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 840M
  • DirectX: Version 8.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64 Bit Only

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3)
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
